title: Do I need car insurance?
text:
Yes - it's illegal to not have car insurance.

At the very least, your car insurance needs to cover you in case you damage someone's property or injure them.

But if you want extra protection, you can choose comprehensive cover. That comes in four levels of cover, with our Platinum cover being the highest.

It includes more benefits and higher cover limits, so you can have extra peace of mind on the road.
